notes.title: Pilgrim: Descent Protocol 0.4.0 is now live on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="QAFAPJOjRq8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Welcome to everyone checking out the game![/p][p]I’m pleased to announce that [b]Pilgrim: Descent Protocol[/b] has launched into Early Access.[/p][p][b]Day 1[/b] arrives with [b]update v0.4.0[/b]. Please feel free to check out the full patch notes below.[/p][p]If you run into any bugs or issues please post them in the Community Forums.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]0.4.0 PATCH NOTES[/h1][h2]HIGHLIGHTS[/h2][list][*][p]Day/Night Cycle added[/p][/*][*][p]Colonies[/p][/*][*][p]Introduction changes[/p][/*][*][p]Sola adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory created/added[/p][/*][*][p]Additional NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Hoverbike adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]New particle effects[/p][/*][*][p]Equipable armors[/p][/*][*][p]Store items[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]DAY/NIGHT CYCLE[/h2][p]Originally, the game was only set at night. The game has now been updated thematically and gameplay-wise to accommodate the change. The world now cycles through day and night. You can also use pods inside your colony or bases to change the time. Additional crawlers spawn at night.[/p][h2]COLONIES[/h2][p]There are now various POH Colonies located around the map. This update introduces the beginnings of colonies. Currently, there are a handful of NPCs, and special gear can be purchased at each colony.[/p][h2]INTRODUCTION CHANGES[/h2][p]A small change to the introduction accommodates the player beginning the game in a colony. The introduction sequence will be further expanded in the future.[/p][h2]SOLA ADJUSTMENTS[/h2][p]Sola has had slight adjustments to her personality and guidelines. Sola will also react in particular ways as you complete your mission to activate each relay.[/p][h2]INVENTORY[/h2][p]A basic inventory system has been added and will be expanded upon as development continues. Items can now be stored and collected, and armors can be equipped/unequipped.[/p][h2]ARMORS[/h2][p]You can now equip various armor on your Pilgrim! Equipping armor will affect your Oxygen, Jump, Health, and more. Armors can be found in chests or scattered across the environment. Each NPC colony also has a unique set of armor that can be purchased.[/p][h2]ADDITIONAL NPCs[/h2][p]Additional NPCs have been added throughout the world. Find them within colonies or while exploring![/p][h2]PURCHASE BUILDINGS[/h2][p]You can now collect materials and use them to purchase buildings that will appear in your colony.
Currently, there are four buildings to choose from. Your colony can only support three buildings, so keep that in mind![/p][h2]HOVERBIKE ADJUSTMENTS[/h2][p]The hoverbike is no longer granted by default. Hoverbikes can be purchased at other colonies or, if you build a Mechanic within your own colony, you can obtain one there.[/p][h2]NEW PARTICLE EFFECTS[/h2][p]Various particles have been added and tweaked, such as the firing particle, fog particles, and more.[/p]

notes.title: Mutiny Island Gameplay FAQ
notes.content:
Today we will be sharing some additional information on Mutiny Island!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/709490/Mutiny_Island/

[i][b]--SWIMMING--[/b][/i]
The whole game world is open right from the beginning.
You can swim anywhere there's water but you will risk the possibility of drowning and losing items doing so. Swimming often will increase your Swimming Skill and duration that you can stay afloat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/cda4020f3139cc071fd5c680abaea658ff8f4e1c.png[/img]

[i][b]--DEATH--[/b][/i]
Passing out from lack of stamina, enemy damage or drowning will result in you respawning back on Mutiny Island or a bed that you've made your designated home. You will also lose some basic items and equipment upon death or drowning. Weapons and armor that you have actively equipped will not be lost.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/59e0b5868bc3a2304fb75135be2e0e098b019464.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/89db627809768a18f76205dcbec9661d8e51de7b.jpg[/img]

[i][b]--DAY & NIGHT--[/b][/i]
A Day and Night Cycle dictates how the world changes around you. 
Different wildlife, monsters and NPC's will appear based on the region, time and day.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/ff0b2aa4151051dafada3954809fd065fe79d517.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/90242fa6ca457f1da2f83eaac45542f297d4b10a.png[/img]

[b][i]--STATS--[/i][/b]
Stats such as CHARM and LUCK will affect your interactions with NPC's
and Shopkeepers. Increasing the various stats in the game can result in you being able to negotiate better sale prices or assist in seducing women.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/cbb5bb19e20f77cc61f225b8e70a9d0465a2caca.jpg[/img]

[i][b]--RED DAWN PREPAREDNESS--[/b][/i]
There is a "Red Dawn Preparedness" meter which tracks how capable you are of challenging the Red Dawn at any given moment. This bar will increase or decrease based on your level, currently equipped equipment and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/a153e5f1b814a1ca82b6bcb42c80bb160f9a1323.png[/img]

[i][b]--RESOLUTION--[/b][/i]
Mutiny Island can be played in a variety of resolutions. Change the resolution in game at anytime using the Options menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/0c32676ec08bbf3db33ff09542b3f86cdeba9dc4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/ff0b2aa4151051dafada3954809fd065fe79d517.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35239539/09b2332d587cc09ba8d4d5e8025f8ee1bbbdc396.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year + 2018 ROADMAP + PROJECT: ARG
notes.content:
[b]Happy New Year!!![/b]

I hope you've all had a fantastic holiday season.
Now that it's a new year, it's time to share some of the plans which are in motion for Elushis Music & Gaming in 2018 and beyond.

[h1][b]Elushis Music & Gaming 2018 ROADMAP:[/b][/h1]

Game Title: [b]PROJECT: ARG[/b]
Platforms: PC/MAC
Genre: SCI-FI, RPG,TRAVERSAL, SIM
Projected Release: Q1 2018 

The only info which I can share at the moment is that it is a top-down 2D game. 

PROJECT: ARG focuses on bringing a more structured, challenging, restricted and replayable experience while retaining the aspects of freedom within the core-gameplay itself.

[h1][b]--After The End: The Harvest Stand-alone DLC/Expansion--[/b][/h1]
DLC Title: [b]Apollo[/b]
Projected Release: Q1-Q2 2018

Undertake a compelling origin story involving Apollo, Lanui, and Orkess which directly leads up to the events of After The End: The Harvest.

[h1][b]--Elushis Music & Gaming Publishing--[/b][/h1]
Game Title: [b]Scarlett Vain[/b]
Platforms: PC,MAC
Genre: Fantasy/Sci-Fi, 2D, Adventure, Action-RPG
Projected release: Q2 2018 

"Follow Bounty Hunter, Scarlett Vain on a quest for money and power as she hunts down powerful monsters across the three islands of Denmonoss". 

Not directly developed by Elushis Gaming, but will be assisted and published by the Elushis Music & Gaming brand. 
More info on this title will be released soon. 

[h1][b]--WEST WATER--[/b][/h1]
Game Title: [b]West Water[/b]
Platforms: PC/MAC/Linux +TBC
Genre: 3D, PVP, Action

Player-Versus-Player (PVP) Multiplayer game involving solo, or team-based, On-Foot and Vehicle Combat. Players compete in a ruthless free-for-all across various maps and games modes, as they attempt to gain control of the last vehicle available in an apocalypse. More information on this title will be released at a later date.

notes.title: V1.1 Update + Cheats Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Welcome to all the new players that have joined us during launch and the Summer Sale!
A new update has just been released which contains the following:

--V1.1.0 Patch Notes--

-Cheats Menu-
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/9f9acffe8e8762b12a880013735cad360d87f907.png[/img]
A Cheat menu has been added to the game!
If you're starting a fresh file from V1.1 you will receive the Cheat Menu right after the first tutorial, when you first reach Planet Andromedas. If starting an Adventure Mode file, you will receive the Cheat Menu with all of your other starting items. Using cheats will disable all Steam Achievements so make sure you save on a separate file!

Some of the cheats include:
All Weapons/Ether Spells
99X Fuel
Angry NPC'S
+ More!

If you'd like to access the Cheat Menu on your current pre V1.1 save file, head over to the Habitat Simulator on the lower level of the E.A.P. 
You will see a Sparkling Item over the terminals. The terminals can be seen in the picture posted above. (Top Corners of Pic) Once you've received the item, The Cheats Menu can be accessed from within your "Key Items" tab, alongside your System Options and Bestiary.

-Molten Bird (Volcaniana), Nightwing Bird Habitat fix-
Under Certain conditions, these two pets would not spawn in the Habitat Simulator once being caught. This has been fixed. If you have already caught these monsters, they will now appear inside the Habitat Simulator and will be able to join your party.

-Two Handed Weapons now have a (2H) Affix next to their name

-Various weapon description updates

-Bounty Hunter ships which appear while being WANTED in Space have had slight AI and Weapon tweaks

-Gigantes Axe Damage has been lowered

-Other various small adjustments

In the last two weeks, some of you may have also noticed that a few small hotfix patches were released. These patches were released to address some issues which were posted within the forums. Check out the forums if you want more info on those updates.

Thanks, everyone!

notes.title: Update V0.9 Out Now + Patch Notes
notes.content:
V0.9 is now live!

As mentioned in the last announcement, this update is not compatible with prior saves. If you're enjoying your current playthrough then I would recommend disabling the update until you're ready. I apologize to those who are inconvenienced but it has been necessary to do this before the release of V1.0.

Patch notes for Beta update V0.9:

-Rune/Socketing System
A Socketing System has been added for Weapons, Armor's and Accessories which will allow players to increase the base stats of almost any equipment that can be found/purchased in ATE:TH. All stats can be increased. 
For example- ATK, HP, MP, AGI, LUK, MD, MAT etc. 
Runes can be found in three variations. 
+1
+3
+5
All equipment has a different amount of Socket Slots which Runes can be equipped into. The maximum amount of Slots which equipment can have is three. +1 and +3 Runes can be dropped from monsters, found/looted in the environment and acquired from various chests around the Universe. +5 Runes are rarer and more difficult to find. The Socketing menu can be accessed from within the "Equip" tab.

-AI Adjustments for most friendly/neutral alien races
Various races have had further adjustments to their AI.
If you killed one of these NPC's in prior versions, the NPC would generally begin running away from you in fear. In V0.9, killing an NPC may still result in them running away, but may also result in the NPC getting gutsy and attacking you. If you begin killing NPC's which are running away, they may decide to stop running and will begin to attack you instead, in self-defence. 
Balloon Icons have also been added to help display the emotion of the NPC.

-New areas have been added to Planet Hopa and Planet Everest

-Day/Night and Climate System Tweaks
In prior versions, entering a building would pause the Day/Night cycle. In V0.9, the Day/Night Cycle will still continue operating even when inside of a building. Make sure you have your Flashlight/Lantern handy when scavenging at night!

-Ancient Inscriptions have been added across various Cave Networks around the Universe. These Inscriptions also have a Quest Line which can be triggered from Planet Seria.

-Lighting Update
Lighting inside of most buildings has been increased to help players navigate in night-time environments.

-Planet World Maps Cosmetic Upgrades
Various Planet World Maps have had small cosmetic upgrades/changes.

-Environmental Loot Adjustments
Runes, Weapons and more can now be looted/found a bit more frequently

-Various small bug and passability fixes

-Other various adjustments and surprises

Expect another announcement soon for the final release date of V1.0
If any bugs are found, please continue posting them in the forums.

Thanks, everyone!

notes.title: Fishing, Housing + More! V0.8 Out Now
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

V0.8 is now live!

Beta Patch V0.8 includes Fishing, Housing, Bug Fixes and more!

Beta Patch Notes V0.8:

PLAYER HOUSING:
-Players can now purchase three homes that are located across the various Galaxies.
Purchasing or acquiring a House Key from a Landlord will allow you to take ownership of the unique properties.

Each home includes its own furniture which you can lightly personalize and arrange. If you're playing on Adventure Mode, you will also unlock a Save Point. 
Food items such as Raw Meat, Fish and Apples may also now be cooked, if you place a Stove or Kitchen Bench and interact with it.
Although some furniture is cosmetic, placing items such as "Weapon Racks" may grant the player temporary buffs such as Attack Power Boosts, and Fuel Disablers.


FISHING:
-Fishing Minigame! Across the various Planet World Maps, Boardwalks have appeared which when stood on, can be used to trigger a fishing minigame. Fishing Rods and Bait can be purchased from various merchants for a 
small fee. Caught Fish can also be cooked inside of the new homes to increase their healing benefits.


NEW ACHIEVEMENTS:
-Two new Steam achievements have been added which relate to the new Fishing and Housing features

OTHER:
-Menu's/Window Skins Cosmetic Update

-Item/Weapon Color Rarity Fixes

-NPC drops and Monster drops tweaks

-NPC AI adjustments

-Various chests of loot added

-BGM and SE adjustments

-A bug was discovered with the System Options menu, specifically, changing the BGM, or SE levels
wouldn't save after adjusting. This has been corrected.

-Bug discovered which would allow the player to obtain a "Teleport Item" from Story Mode while playing in Adventure Mode. This has been fixed.

-Other various tweaks, balances, and surprises

notes.title: Adventure (Challenge) Mode Out Now! + Patch V0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Adventure (Challenge Mode) has just been released alongside Beta Patch V0.5! 

Adventure Mode spawns the player randomly in one of eight unique starting locations across the universe, with no tutorial, no clothes, a ship with no fuel and almost no direction on how to get into Space.

Each starting location has various hazards which affect how you'll be able to leave your starting planet/area.

The more you fail, the more you learn what are the right and wrong decisions.

Save Points are far and few between, and the simplest mistake can sometimes mean disastrous results.

Adventure Mode is perfect for those players that are looking for a more challenging open world experience. 

This new mode can be played separately from Story and also contains its own unique set of Achievements. You can access
Adventure Mode by starting a new game from the main menu.

Beta Patch V0.5 also includes the following-

-Weather tint effect has been reduced to help with visibility on extreme planets

-Icons for certain Bow weapons have been updated

-Typo fixes for various parts including but not limited to the Story introduction sequences, as well as various NPC's.

-Passability fixes on Planet Toxicia and other various world maps and interiors

-4 new Achievements added for Adventure (Challenge)  Mode

-Various minor bug fixes

If you encounter any bugs please post them within the forums.

Thanks guys!

1 Star/Sun
2 Planets
1 Moon
+Space

notes.title: 24/11/16 Sandbox Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new patch has been uploaded onto the Sandbox Branch which includes a few graphical tweaks, and some fixes for bugs that have been reported within the forums these past two weeks.

--PATCH NOTES--
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/92a71e641c262d1da498a5cbe68f3371d0d46bcc.png[/img]

A Grapple Post had been found earlier within the Eklekton Isles region which was slightly out of reach when heading back down the mountain. 
This bug wasn't game breaking, but the Grapple Post has now been moved into it's correct location and the area can be explored freely.

Noorta Cave BGM Crash-

A crash would occur when entering a certain cave within Planet Noorta due to a missing file. This has been fixed.

Graphical Tweaks-
Planet Noorta and Sunyera have had slight graphical tweaks and additions.

Direction Fix Bug-
Fixed an issue which would cause the Direction Fix/Strafe Button to cease functioning after completing certain quests, in a certain order. This bug would fix itself after the next major cutscene, but nevertheless, has been fixed now.

Passability Within Three Merkun City Interiors-
When entering three specific interiors within "Merkun City" in Planet Noorta, the players character would be stuck behind an invisible wall. 
This has been fixed.

--END PATCH NOTES--

I have received a few questions asking why I haven't switched "Crash Landed" onto the main branch. If the community does not mind it, I'd be happy to have Crash Landed as the main build and V0.09u5 as the secondary, but it would mean that, 
if possible, or need be, the community would have to help assist any new players understand the process that the game has undertaken during development/Early Access.

Although "Crash Landed" techincally has less planets then V0.09u5, players have expressed that they prefer the overall game, systems and structure much more, and personally I would have to agree. CL is much more representative of the final coming product. If any one has any thoughts, queries or objections, please feel free to ask!

Thanks guys!

notes.content:

Content Update slightly delayed. Hopefully released within next 24-48 hours.

(31/10/16)
Hi everyone,

The latest update is almost complete and just going through the last few rounds of polishing. The planned release for this update is 5/11/16 (this coming weekend). 
Below is a comprehensive list of of the major changes, features and additions to the core systems, as well as a few other things.

Notes/Patch Notes for the upcoming After The End: The Harvest Crash Landed- 

Notes-
After The End: The Harvest Sandbox is a standalone update which uses most of the core systems, and graphical engines/assets from the upcoming full version of After The End: The Harvest. The Sandbox contains it's own unique planets, and section of space which won't be present in the full game. ATE:TH Sandbox will be free for all Early Access players. 

This update will contain over 30 new quests, new weapons, unique endings and much more. The main purpose of the Sandbox is to stress test some of the new gameplay systems such as Creature Battling/Catching, Real-Time Spaceship Combat and more, that have been worked on over the last few months. The Creature Battling System for example, is constructed universally. Any bugs that are possibly found within this version, the fixes will carry over into the final game. Go crazy with the systems guys!
This build is an official representation of what is to come, and be expected within the final release. The Sandbox has hours of new content, but in comparison to the full game is roughly one fifteenth of it's size. This update is being released to give players an opportunity to experience,discuss and comment on some of the changes that have been made with the overall systems. 

Below is a list of Patch Notes, which reference some of the changes made since the last official Steam EA version V0.09u5.

Update Notes-

Creature Battling/Catching-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/f2eda98541e0ee539e4de79223ec2a8653d52d8c.png[/img]
A new creature catching and battling system has been added. Most creatures/enemies can now be caught if you have the correct launcher.

Creatures are classified into three groups. 
(P) Primitive Creatures-
(P) Creatures are generally non sentient, and in their first stage of growth. They are weaker to their more mature (C) and (S) counterparts. (P) Creatures require a "Primitive Launcher" and "Primitive Capture Spheres" to be captured. 

(C) Common Creatures-
(C) Creatures require a "Common Launcher" and "Common Capture Spheres" to be captured. Common Creatures are generally more stronger then their younger (P) counterparts. Some Common Creatures have no further growth stages.

(S) Supreme Creatures-
(S) Creatures are the strongest that can be caught. All Supreme creatures have no further growth stages. (S) Creatures require a "Supreme Launcher" and "Supreme Capture Spheres" to be caught. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/d3376e3d0099067f676cc83c2e5c46e67bba70a1.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/883e31410eafb59d64ebde463c2817675c4b1b3b.png[/img]

Defeating an enemy with the launcher captures it, and sends it to your registered "Creature Habitat". Creatures can evolve, level up, be equipped with different items, armours and more. Battle Masters can also be found around the Galaxy, which when challenged, initiate a turn based battle system between yours, and the Battle Masters creature. If you defeat a Battle Master, you are awarded with an Arena Coin, which can then be traded in for better catching equipment. All creatures caught, also help you fight against enemies, and travel with you as a companion across the Black Eye Galaxy.

Real Time Spaceship Combat-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/32226dbbb8fb3ea00ae5a75f90918fd04b56ed84.png[/img]
Real Time Spaceship Combat will finally make it's debut. Combat works seamlessly alongside exploration, and includes collectable ship armours, powerful launchers and more. There is also different classes of Spaceships ranging from Fighter to Cargo Classes, that all have their own weapons and unique enhancements. Different ships can be bought, or stolen.

Visual Armour-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/0053ed80b88471760754b82bbb35b483475a5bbc.png[/img]
When equipping armour in V0.09u5, there would be no visible changes to your character. When equipping armour now, your character will change in appearance. If you wear no armour, you can run around shirtless.

Control Changes-
Controls have been completely overhauled and simplified. Excluding armours and accessories, There is now only two equip-able Weapon/Ether Spell slots, rather then the 8 before. Players can equip usable Weapons/Ether Spells into the "Main" And "Secondary" slots within the equip menu. Mouse controls have also been completely removed to accommodate the changes, as well as help simplify the controls and open up seamless Gamepad Plug 'N' Play functionality.

UI Changes-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/47b09ad26c8cef70314fed53b0845e2ba97074fb.png[/img]
The UI has been de-cluttered tremendously. Side bar icons, and bottom toolbar have been removed, as everything has now been redesigned into one handy inventory menu. Everything can now be accessed through the one menu, rather then the clunky icon based system that exists within V0.09u5.

Performance Boost-
Huge performance boost in many areas!

Dynamic Lighting-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/832cb698fd3abd8568d7d047835a16f419879b93.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/2078638164ff1dc0bd4667ecf33f2f6afff2defd.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/9c7aa44ea0036c64503992e67550f724367c37a8.png[/img]
Lighting has been added into the game, and helps enhance the overall graphics, as well as play a role in gameplay mechanics and puzzle solving. 

Spaceship Boost-
A button can now be pressed/held to initiate a boost in speed.
This boost varies between different class of spaceships but is an invaluable way to travel either way. 

Space Redesigned-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/9dbe43f9b991c14ec54d249c1d66ea1880cc27a3.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/73a0910eb6182db95dca3419d34fbfae74b5abae.png[/img]
The open world space environments are now more beautiful then ever! Nebula's have been added, dynamic lighting, space floating, destroyable asteroids and more.

Space Floating-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/6b1f437de4f7a7cb3d0fdb50280f0aa5ed5fcf70.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/577fb9d2992f25aec72bc87ef7b7d11d8a6d5d3a.png[/img]
Walking off the edge of floating ruins and other areas within space will allow you to freely drift through the cosmos. Make sure you have a Spacesuit if you want to survive!

Spaceship Mode 7 Removed-
Mode 7 has unfortunately been removed. This was because of its incompatibilities with the recently implemented Real Time Spaceship Combat System.
If early players are aware of the original Mode 7 that the game launched with, that will possibly be brought into the final version, but able to be toggled on/off.

Combat System Tightened Up-
Combat feels more weighted, balanced and overall less floaty. Range of weapons has also been overhauled and drastically improved in just about every way. Ether Spells are more organised, and can be combined with items into new, more powerful spells. Spells also have brand new animations.

Combining Items/Ether Spells-
The crafting system has been redesigned into a simpler "Combining System". 
Finding recipes, helps players combine two items into something new. 
As an example, adding an ingredient from a creature to a spell, will make the spell grow into a newer, stronger spell. Items can also be combined into different items such as Potions,Lockpicks and more. Recipes are not required to make items, but do make it much easier then guessing blindly.

Dialog Choices-
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/0eb587c24333ff90199fc0fc948422ae073adfb9.png[/img]
Some conversations give the player dialogue options, which trigger unique story lines and extra information. Saying the right or wrong thing in a situation could mean avoiding conflict entirely. Selecting certain dialogue will also influence which ending you might trigger.

Fuel System Overhauled-
A nifty fuel gauge appears under the players HP bar when the Spaceship is on or under five units of fuel, and gradually decreases as it approaches zero. Fuel decreases quicker now, but is more abundant. The new system really helps the players choose and consider their next destination more carefully.

Crash Landing Overhauled-
When crash landing with no fuel in V0.09u5, regardless of where you were, would trigger a game over. If you run out of fuel now, and crash on land, you survive and can continue exploring. If you crash in water, you sink and get a game over. Crashing landing in open space, enables you to "Space Float".

House Upgrades + Furniture-
Your home on Planet Noorta can be upgraded with new interiors, furniture, and a backyard. New upgrades/furniture also offer practical features such as lighting, and recovering your HP.

Spaceship Additions-
Spaceship can now be called and entered from anywhere on the world map/space. No more losing your ship in the wilds!

Guards + Bounty System Changes-
Bounties can now be cleared by paying a fee within most religious establishments in towns and cities. When attacking a guard, villagers living in that city will begin to run away and scream when you try and approach them. Bounties also clear naturally after a certain amount of time has passed.

Destroy Cities-
If you acquire a certain launcher for your Spaceship, you can attempt to destroy cities. Destroying a city, makes it impossible for you to renter it, but does net some large rewards. Attacking a city also visually destroys it on the world map, and spawns enemy spaceships which attempt to hunt and destroy the player. Destroying a city can also disable certain side quests, or relocate them under changed conditions.

+More

The full game includes ALL of these systems and more, but I hope this standalone Sandbox update, really let's you all know the kind of work that has been put into the game over the last 7 months. The full game is coming along well, but is just simply not finished. I'm sure everyone who has played any prior version of ATE:TH, will understand the future of the game when playing through this standalone prologue, and I hope that anyone new to the game will enjoy it just as much. I hope you all enjoy the beginning story from the universe of After The End: The Harvest.

Thanks guys!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/85b3779b4447bc02a8339e326248f3ddd404ded3.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/e14a0b76a58b9cf84c85b026facf0102f4ea516a.png[/img]


WORLD MAPS-
World maps are back and they are bigger then ever!
Planets now consist of different regions or "Countries" which are home to many different villages, dungeons and more.
When wandering around the various planets, the name of the country will fade in and out on the side of the screen. This will also extend to Space, where travelling between Deep Space and other Galaxies will trigger text which informs the player of their location.
Below is a scaled down screen shot of roughly one quarter of the Plant Seria world map.
(Game is still in development so this map portion will still change)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/8e29150022ffc25891be3bb8ef668d6f653d1bb9.jpg[/img]



PLANETS-
I'm happy to confirm that the full version of After The End: The Harvest will include over 15 explorable planets. Most planets will also have seperate explorable moons, with their own locations as well. (Similar to the current playable Steam build). In terms of the games size alone, the current playable build includes roughly 300 maps. Once again, I dont want to spoil much, but this number in development is now well and truely in the thousands. The game has grown in size, performance and polish tremendously since the latest public update. The game has never looked, or run this good and I sincerely cannot wait for you all to experience it. 

VISUAL ARMOR-
If you look closely in the screenshots above, you can see different styles of armor and clothing options which will be included in the full game. Clothing will be paramount when exploring certain kinds of areas, and occasions.


HUD UI-
A fuel gauge will be added when flying any of your Spaceships.
In the current Steam build, you can track your fuel consumption by equipping the fuel item to your hotbar during flights. In the coming version, you will be able to find a gauge which automatically appears when taking off and tracks your usage. 
Very helpful when planning your trips through space!
Another useful feature coming soon is the oxygen indicator, whenever you enter an area which has no oxygen, a notification will pop up to inform you.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/f9b8a188e3a5761a7b3af22cfde5b695922fa0ba.png[/img]

SPACESUIT UPGRADE-
The Spacesuit will in the future, by default, include a Grapplinghook.

NPC'S-
All NPC facesets will be matching. Most NPC's will also have multiple pieces of dialog when spoken to repeatedly. Some NPC's can also be questioned through dialogue branches. When attacking a friendly NPC or village guard in the current Steam version, only Guards would react. In the coming version, guards will still attack, but NPC's will now also run away from the player and begin screaming untill the disturbance is over.

SETTLEMENTS-
Settlements will work in conjuction with the Earth's Assembly Point which was referenced in prior announcements.
Around the universe you will encounter many different humans and aliens with different proffesions. Persuading some to join you back on the Assembly Point will prove invaluable when trying to figure out the right combinations of settlement survival.

Do you send two medics and one soldier when building a settlement on a planet full of monsters? Or two soldiers and one medic on a plot of land being held by helpless natives. Depending on your choices and combinations, your settlers will either survive or perish. Scouting a location first can give you tips on the type of hazards which are needed to be overcome for succesful survival. Succesful settlements attract rare merchants and provide gold at a regular interval.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9341548/c50fac571411cb8687ed7f2ec73862eedc590cf3.png[/img]

More information coming soon!
Thank you everyone for the continued support.

notes.title: Dev Update: Visual Equipment V0.09u6
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Just a quick dev update on the upcoming V0.09u6 patch.

I'm pleased to announce that visual equipment will be arriving in patch V0.09u6!
When equipping armours, your characters clothes will change instantly, and can also be viewed from within the main menu.

A few more changes which will be arriving in V0.09u6-

-The space overworld is now almost twice as large, and contains over double the amount of exsisting planets, with more being added as we speak. The added planets contain new mechanics, quests, environments, enemies and alien races.

-The main story line has been expanded, and modified to account for the change in the games scale. Galaxies will also be seperated by sections of "Deep Space".  This can all be traversed without any loading screens.
More info on Deep Space will be announced closer to release of the patch.

-In the current playable build of ATE:TH, on certain planets, you can find seperate sections of caves, and underground tunnels. In the upcoming patch, the underground systems have been expanded, and will become one large open dungeon which can be completely traversed on foot to access different parts of a planet.
Underground sections, depending on the planet, will also contain monsters, villages, treasure and more. 

-Enemy skillsets have been tightened up, and some reworked completely. Enemies will still spawn semi-randomly, but within pre-determined sections of planets/space. As an example, enemies which look like they belong in a forest, will generally be found within forests etc. In other words, enemies will spawn within certain habitats, but not in exactly the same locations. 
Most biological enemy types have also been expanded and will now include baby versions, adult versions and giant versions which spawn under certain conditions.  

-When defeating certain enemies in the current playable version, a textbox would appear which displayed the various items that had been dropped. This would pause the flow of gameplay and caused some players a little bit of annoyance. That system has now been changed with enemies still dropping items, but without any pause to gameplay.

-Settlement mechanics

-Graphics have been updated, and are now more consistent in overall art style. All NPC and character faces have been updated. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sd51mby.png[/img] - Opa Race
[img]http://i.imgur.com/l4nLkJA.png[/img] - Burgia Race

These are just some of the changes and additions which will be coming within the next patch.

Now is the time to get excited.
Thank you everyone for the continued support!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Po38dqP.jpg[/img]

notes.title: V0.09 Patch Now Live! Spaceship Combat + More
notes.content:
Hey guys,

The latest patch has just gone live. This update includes a host of fixes, performance boosts, graphical upgrades and much more. Unfortunately old save files will not be able to carry over onto this build.
For full patch notes check out the list below.

V0.09u1 Patch Notes-

SPACESHIP COMBAT-
As requested throughout last year, a form of Spaceship combat has been added to the core game. Spaceship combat can be initialized while flying through space. A battle will begin if you run into an enemy ship, or if an enemy ship runs into you. Enemy ships drop Materials, Items and more. Spaceship Weapons and Armors can also be found by destroying various enemy ships and bosses. Teleport terminals have also been added throughout various locations in the galaxy. Teleport terminals will enable you to change and equip your Spaceships armor and weaponry that you have collected throughout the galaxy.

ADVENTURE MODE (Hard Mode)-
A new mode is now available when starting a new game.
Adventure mode includes random starting locations and more. 
You can find more information within the game.

Revamped Skill Progression-
In previous versions new magic skills would be mainly learnt as you level up. This has been changed in V0.09, and skills
can now be unlocked in almost any order by spending SP(Skill Points). SP can be earned by fighting, levelling up and collecting Magic Shards.
Certain skills can only be purchased once their lesser forms are bought first.

Magic Shards-
Magic Shards can now be found all over the galaxy. When found, a Magic Shard grants the player 200SP which can be used to purchase new Magic Skills.

New Weapons/Item Rarity-
Items are now colour coded and have different levels of rarity. 
Over a dozen new weapons and armours have also been added.

Menu-
The main menu during gameplay has been updated and now shows many useful stats. The Quick-Equip Menu can still be accessed through the side bar icons, or the new menu itself. Items such as potions can also now be used directly from within the menu.

Morality Metre-
A metre now appears in your menu which tracks the players behaviour. Attacking most civilians and friendly NPC'S will affect your
morality in a negative way, while helping entities with quests and requests makes it positive.

Health Regen-
HP now automatically regenerates during gameplay at a limited rate.

New HP and MP HUD-

Visibility Range-
A visibility range has been added which changes based on the time of day.

Fullscreen Prompt-
A prompt has been added when launching the game which asks the user if they would prefer Fullscreen/Window.

Performace Boost-
The game has been further optimized and should run better then before on most systems.

Title Screen Upgrade-
Scrolling title screen has been updated.

Shifting Enemy Locations-
Enemies now spawn semi-randomly throughout most areas.

Item Transform-
Certain items such as bullets, once used, break down into lesser crafting components.

Diagonal Movement For Enemies-
Enemies no longer zig-zag to get towards the player and now move in a more fluid motion.

Right Click Cancel Fix-
Right Click can now be used to cancel out of menus and open the map while on foot.

Storage Boxes/Inventory Weight-
Storage boxes can be found across various parts of the galaxy which enable you to stash away excess goods. The inventory is also now limited in carrying capacity, and if exceeded in room,
will stop the player from sprinting unless they discard or sell the excess items. 
Carrying capacity increases with each level.

New Item Indicator-
A small icon now appears whenever the player picks up a new item. This icon dissapears once the item is inspected.

Other various bug fixes and improvements.

Because of the amount of changes and additions to the game, it is possible that some bugs may occur. I will be monitoring this patch closely so
if anyone runs into any bugs, please post them in the discussion boards so they can be checked out.

Unfortunately, due to the inclusion of Spaceship Combat, the Orialis Galaxy was not included in this update but will still be coming sometime soon.
Please check out past announcements for details on the upcoming galaxy.

Thanks everyone!

The Tigra are a proud and nomadic race which constantly travels around the Orialis Galaxy looking for new challengers of strength. [img]http://i.imgur.com/20MuiYI.png[/img]

An honorable and compassionate race of walking and flying canines. The Lupus are the most technologically advanced race within Orialis and tend to steer away from the battles of dominance which occur within space. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BV0dlJj.png[/img]

Location Popup + Overall Font Changes-
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ruQFlTz.png[/img]

+More!

Using certain items such as potions will now leave you with left over materials, which can be used for crafting. notes.title: 4/12/15 Patch
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

I'm happy to announce that a new patch has gone live!
This is a moderate sized patch and includes quite a few changes and additions. 

Patch Notes-

Auto Save-
A simple auto-save system has been implemented. 
The auto-save file can be loaded from the "Continue" menu on the start screen.

Just start/continue your game, and the auto save slot should appear automatically at the top of the list. You can still make seperate saves at any time by clicking the "Red Book" icon on the sidebar.

Spawning Guards-
Before this latest patch, killing civilians within the game wouldn't have much consequence, apart from their death itself, as well as a little bit of G and EXP.
This new patch introduces alien race-specific guards for most populated city areas. These guards will appear and chase after the player if they have commited some sort of crime. The guards essentially have 3 stages-

-Chase Phase
Once a death has been witnessed, guards will chase the player. Killing a guard while they are in the chase phase will mean that you have made your decision, and ignoring arrest. This will cause all of the guards for the specific race to go after the player with force.

-Reason Phase
Guards from various alien races have different options, some may just attack, while others will try and send you to jail once they catch you.

-Attack Phase
This happens when you have killed another guard, or resisted arrest.

Becoming hostile with a race will also mean that you are more prone to attacks from their guards which wander the galaxy. A new NPC can also be found in Heavensreach which can clear your crimes for a fee.
The guard system will continue to be expanded more as development continues.

Planet Graphics Updated-
The planet graphics within space have been updated and look much more planet-e. 

Space Map Icons-
The icons which appear when discovering a new location within space have been updated and de-cluttered.
A few new discoverable locations have also been added. The places themselves have been in the game for a while, but now these certain asteroids will pop up with the appropriate "Location Discovered" dialog. 

Minor Graphical Updates-
Minor graphical updates within the planet Anubia and Narui.

Map Item Optimizations-
Opening/closing maps loads faster.

Engine Optimizations-
Backend changes have been made which improve the overall performance of the game.

Various Shop Vendor Fixes-

Updated Defence Turrent Description-

Thanks everyone!!

notes.title: Welcome New Players + Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

I just wanted to take a moment and say hello to the new players of After The End: The Harvest. I hope you are all enjoying your travels throughout the galaxy. If you run into any issues, please post them in the discussion board so they can be looked into.

Since the launch of V0.08 a lot of things have been changed and updated within the game. 
Large content updates have generally been defined as V0.01, V0.02 etc. 
Each numbered content update has brought in large-scale changes and additions, but patches have also been released inbetween large numbered updates which have included things like bug fixes and extra add on content. 

V0.08 introduced the worlds, and story which you are all currently familiar with. 

In versions V0.07 and below, the story structure and space overworld was different and planets worked a little differently. Going from space into a planet, would take you to a seperate overworld map similar to world maps seen in classic Final Fantasy games.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RNEX6Kc.png[/img]

This was changed, and completely redesigned in V0.08. Flying directly into a planet in space, would now take you into the planet directly, with all of the villages exsisting all within one large world similar to games like Fallout.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uFLV26o.png[/img]

This has made the overall transition from space and planets feel much more seamless, and given the game a much more open-world feeling design. 

V0.08 also introduced the main story line involving the mysterious ancient race known as the Anukai, spacesuit/jump , mouse support, combat arena, crafting, fishing, new weapons/skills, companions, new ships/spaceship blueprints, new locations and much more. 

With the launch of large numbered updates, bugs are always a possibility, especially within the development phase. 

Thankfully, most of the issues that have been posted as well as more, have been fixed.

I have mentioned in the last couple of announcements that work on V0.09 is progressing, and that I will hopefully be able to release it soon. For those unaware, V0.09 will introduce a whole new galaxy with its own new explorable space overworld and enterable planets, as well as the continuation of the overall main story. I still cant give an exact date on the release, but it will definantely be before the end of the year just in time for the holidays. 

Thank you all for playing After The End: The Harvest and I hope you will enjoy the coming update V0.09!

If you have a request or any questions, please feel free to ask them below or in the discussion boards.

notes.title: Summon Fixes
notes.content:
Hello again. 

I've just fixed up a few more issues that I have encountered.

For anyone who has just joined the development of the game, the latest release V0.08 has been getting lots of fixes because the game underwent a huge upgrade in almost every aspect of the game compared to the prior V0.07. 

If your curious as to what the game was like earlier, you can check out a trailer here- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qIPHKxc9-D8

Because the  V0.08 update was so large, This in turn has created a few bugs which I have been fixing as they appear. 

I've received a couple negative reviews since the launch of the newest version from a few players which has unfortunately brought the score down from a Mostly Positive 77% to an unfortunate Mixed 58%. I completely understand if someone doesn't like the game but its just a little confusing for me, as I'm certain that V0.08 is leaps and bounds better then V0.07. Either way, work will continue! 

Patch Notes-
-Fixed issue with summons not being given to the player once a Titan is killed
-Fixed passability issues on the Andromedas and Hopa moons
-Fixed the entrance for the beachside caves on the Planet Hopa where the Titan Cerberus resides
-Fixed issues where you could walk on some select interior walls 
-Reduced the Titan Methuselas Defence
-Other various bug and text fixes

To enjoy this latest update simply-
Right click the game on Steam
Click "Properties"
Select "Local Files" and click "Verify Integrity Of Game Cache"
You will then receive an update of roughly 16mb containing the fixes.

If for some reason this doesn't apply the fixes please delete local content and just do a fresh re-download.

Previous save files are still compatible, but if you have already killed certain Titans, you unfortunately will not be able to acquire their specific summon skill, but you will still be able to get the others. 

If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review of your experience on the store page. 

Thanks guys!

notes.title: JoyToKey Controller Support
notes.content:
Hi guys I just had a little mess around with JoyToKey, and I'm happy to say that the game ran pretty much flawlessley. 
I tried it out with a PS3 controller, and these were the keybindings I used-

(Just move the mouse out of the screen although not necessary)

X= NUM1: Main Weapon Attack/Interact
R1= NUM2: Secondary Weapons/Rifles
Square= NUM3: Item
Circle= Cancel in menus, Map during gameplay
Triangle= NUM5: Magic Skill
Start= Inventory
R2= Ship Accelerate/Sprint
L2= Quest Log
Select= Companion Attack
Dpad/Control Stick= Movement

(This was just a quick setup so im sure it could be customized to fit alot of peoples needs)

The only trade off is you wont be able to have as many magic skills equipped at the same time, compared to the keyboard setup, but apart from that the game was really fun with the controller.
I've usually been a console gamer and the setup made me feel right at home. 

If you get a moment, give it a try and let me know how you go. If you have any issues let me know and I'll try help out. 

If anyone wants to write a tutorial for other users it would be much appreciated but I will see what I can do. 

You can download JoyToKey here- http://joytokey.net/en/download

I will still be trying to implement a more integrated official controller solution, but for those who dont want to wait this should be more then enough.

Let me know how you all go!

notes.title: V0.08 Release Date Info
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

After The End: The Harvest has grown so much from where it originally started all those months ago. 
Thank you too everyone, for everything! 

The negative, positive and all the inbetweens! 

Your comments and suggestions are at the heart of what the development of this game is all about. 

I have always dreamt of being able to develop a video game and share it with the world. I have worked on music, tv shows and more, but video games is where my heart and passion truely lies. 

I never thought at the beginning of developing this game, that it would even make its way onto Steam, but through the support and motivation from you the players, this has become a reality. 

Thank you!!!!

This is my first commercial game, and I have been working on it completely by myself from the beginning. I have received questions as too why I didn't begin development on Unity instead of RPG Maker, but the answer is pretty simple.

I had never used Unity.
My experience had only lay with RPG Maker, and a few other engines.
RPG Maker is also fantastic too actually make a game like this. 
Its tools are a great foundation for the creation of an open-world game.
Taking into account my skill set at the time, dictated which engine I'd use to try and create my concept.

Flying a ship through space, landing on planets, hunting monsters and taking on quests. I personally have not seen many games that offer those options like After The End: The Harvest does and will do. Usually its only, questing without any kind of flight. Or space flight without any kind of questing. (If you get what I mean)

I want a world with no barriers, one which you can keep travelling through without every hitting any kind of barrier or "invisible wall". 

If you see something, you can go there.
That was the beginning frame of mind for the creation of this game.

It might be no GTA 5 in terms of sales and player numbers, but I can truely say that I'm extremely proud of how far its come already.

Now that the game is published on early-access, and has a much more forseeable future, I will be doing what I can to commision some artists too help with the art side of things. 

The game has reached a much more proffesional level, and I intend to continue pushing the limits of this project as much as I possibly can.

I might be developing, but Im also learning just as much. I will continue to expand my skills so I can create the best possible games that I can.

In saying that, I'm happy to announce that I will be relasing Update V0.08 on the 20th of September. V0.08 will usher in the next stage of development of the game, and makes it much close too the original vision

If you haven't seen the new trailer showing some of the changes you can check it out below-

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E932KHBMYlc

Updates will still continue after the release of V0.08 in the form of bug fixes, and then large numbered updates such as V0.09 etc, which will include more features and playable content.

I'm still aiming for a Nov 1 release, but Im not going to make any gurantees. 
The game should still be completed before we finish up the year.

V0.08 will be a full game, start to finish, but the true last areas, and portions of the game wont be playable untill after release. I'm doing this with the hope that people who play the game during early-access, have a reason to revisit on launch. I'm not going into it too much at the moment, but when you play/finish the game, I think you will understand what I mean.
(Dont worry, there will be a very satisfying ending which will stay true to the overall story, and make you excited for the full release)

Anyways, for everyone who took the time to read through this long announcement, thank you, and I hope you have a better understanding of myself, and the game. 


Thank you everyone!!
V0.08 releasing 20/09/15


P.S-
For whoever is interested in seeing some of the progress of the game through the year, you can check out the original V0.01 trailer below-

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XiSG0KEfUDg

There is heaps of videos on my Youtube channel which show the game changing through development, which I hope you all will appreciate and enjoy.

Hi everyone, I have been extremely busy working on the latest update.
Unfortunately, I haven't been able to finish it as quick as I would have liked so I'm taking the time to let you all know, and post a bit of info on some of the upcoming changes.

List of some of the changes in the upcoming V0.08-

Complete revamp of the planets and space overworld-
(Pictures below are from only one of the updated planets)
Planet Seria-
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ecQEk7g.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PDkSDU3.png[/img]

Planet Seria In Space-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RZEIEpe.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/h9AU6dx.png[/img]

Planets have been completely revamped in how they operate, and how they look. Villages dungeons etc are no longer connected by a world map and are now all in one large open world.

New Space Overworld-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fewfhRi.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ORVcmuS.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/u7zkdnV.png[/img]

Most planets have either one or more moons which function similar to planets but on a smaller scale. Moons also have their own settlements, quests and monsters.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vKvvpsC.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pFOBn76.png[/img]

The space overworld has also been revamped and is now very different.
Apart from cosmetic upgrades, flying through space feels very space-y.

Your character also requires a Spacesuit to breath while exploring asteroids in space. You can explore without a spacesuit, but you will die and get swept away pretty quickly.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wkg9PGx.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wEb3lpP.png[/img]

The spacesuit also comes equipped with a jetpack jump!
You can use the spacesuit to jump and explore vertically.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JEyneAY.png[/img]

The spacesuit also helps against some of the harsh atmospheres present across parts of the game. The spacesuit can be equipped and taken off almost instantously during gameplay.

Choose your name-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qaH8rNO.png[/img]

Self explanatory.

Allocated level up stats-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lMH7A9G.png[/img]

You can now choose a stat to increase each time the player or companion levels up.

Updating World Map-

Map can now be brought up with the "ESC or X" button.
As you play and discover new locations, they will be added too your corresponding maps. Player location and ship location is also shown.

notes.content:
Hi everyone, I have been extremely busy working on the latest update.
Unfortunately, I haven't been able to finish it as quick as I would have liked so I'm taking the time to let you all know, and post a bit of info on some of the upcoming changes.

List of some of the changes in the upcoming V0.08-

Complete revamp of the planets and space overworld-
(Pictures below are from only one of the updated planets)
Planet Seria-
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ecQEk7g.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PDkSDU3.png[/img]

Planet Seria In Space-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RZEIEpe.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/h9AU6dx.png[/img]

Planets have been completely revamped in how they operate, and how they look. Villages dungeons etc are no longer connected by a world map and are now all in one large open world.

New Space Overworld-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fewfhRi.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ORVcmuS.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/u7zkdnV.png[/img]

Also, moons!
Most planets have either one or more moons which function similar to planets but on a smaller scale. Moons also have their own settlements, quests and monsters.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vKvvpsC.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/pFOBn76.png[/img]

The space overworld has also been revamped and is now very different.
Apart from cosmetic upgrades, flying through space feels very space-y.

Your character also requires a Spacesuit to breath while exploring asteroids in space. You can explore without a spacesuit, but you will die and get swept away pretty quickly.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wkg9PGx.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wEb3lpP.png[/img]

The spacesuit also comes equipped with a jetpack jump!
You can use the spacesuit to jump and explore vertically.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JEyneAY.png[/img]

The spacesuit also helps against some of the harsh atmospheres present across parts of the game. The spacesuit can be equipped and taken off almost instantously during gameplay.

Choose your name-

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qaH8rNO.png[/img]

Self explanatory.

Map can now be brought up with the "ESC or X" button.
As you play and discover new locations, they will be added too your corresponding maps. Player location and ship location is also shown.

notes.title: V0.07
notes.content:
V0.07 is now released!

This latest update includes-

-Graphics options toggle: Traditional, mode 7 and mix.
-Fixed fuzziness and interlacing issues
-Stability fixes
-New quests
-Redesigned introduction and beginning location
-Remapped controls
-Wolf SE fix
-New locations
-Weapon fixes

and more!

If the update doesn't install automatically, please delete V0.06 from your local content and reinstall.


Patch Notes-
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Graphics Options Toggle-
There is now three different camera views which the game can be played in,
Classic RPG view is the default top-down perspective, used in most classic JRPG'S
You can also choose between Complete Mode 7, and Classic Mode 7.

Complete Mode 7 includes the quasi 3D angled view and applies to ship flight as well as
walking on foot.

Classic Mode 7 includes the original top down view for walking on foot and Mode 7 angled view for when you pilot your ship.

The game begins in the Classic RPG top down perspective, but can be changed while playing.

(Complete Mode 7 is recommended for people with higher end computers/graphics cards)

These new options also means that the game is able to be run on less powerful hardware, if the game
is left in the default top down view. These new graphical options can be seen in the sense of low, medium and 
high settings with Complete Mode 7 being high and the default view low. You will be able to customize 
these settings further in future versions.

The interlacing issue has been fixed from the last version, there should hopefully be no fuzziness for the people who decide to use the Complete Mode 7 view.

Apart from the toggle, this update also includes a newly designed introduction and beginning location for the game. This introduction will also be added upon in future
versions. 

There is also various other fixes such as the enemy wolf sound effects, and more.

This update also includes the beginning of dialogue branched conversations within the game. 
So far their is only two quest lines which use this, but this will be added upon heavily in the next update. These quest lines are complete, but could still be seen as
unfinished due to being a little unpolished. I was originally going to work on the dialogue branched quests, but had to stop so I could address the issues of 
the interlacing and angled view. 

Update also includes-
Remapped controls
Updated weather effect graphics
Updated Markets
Updated Icons
New graphics for the bestiary
Various Bug fixes

and more.

Next update will be focused on implementing gamepad support, achievements and more playable content.
Hope you all enjoy update V0.07! 

Save file from V0.06 is not compatible with this update due to the restructuring of the engine.
Your save file starting from V0.07 will be carried over in future updates.

If you run into any bugs/glitches please let me know in the "Bugs/Glitches" discussion here- http://steamcommunity.com/app/386140/discussions/0/530646715643890707/
If you have a request for future updates post it here- http://steamcommunity.com/app/386140/discussions/0/530646715643895416/

notes.title: V0.07 Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello again all!

I have been listening to all of your concerns, and doing what I can to address them. The largest issue people have had so far is with the fuzziness during movement. This has been toned down significantly, and is hopefully at an acceptable level for the people who have had issues.

Apart from the "fuzz" fixes, this version will also include a completely redesigned introduction section. You will not be beginning the game in the same place or the same way as you did in all of the prior versions. This is something I have wanted to change since the very first version was released.

This update is mainly to address certain concerns raised with the launch.
This update could be looked at, as the first half of V0.07

Full update notes will be released when the update is live.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: V0.07 Update
notes.content:
Hi again everyone, just a quick note on some of the changes which are coming in the next update.

-Various Graphical fixes, including smoothing out the motion blur, and fuzziness
-Wolf enemy damage SE changed
-Dialogue branches with their own individual quest lines based on your responses in certain areas
-Market NPC's now have their own enterable buildings instead of the docking ramp that currently exists. The shops also now have NPC's which wander in and out, going about their business creating a sense of an even more alive world
-Loads of new locations such as the Ancient Council, Aurion and Reptilian laboratories and more
- The Aurion Collector is an NPC who tasks you with capturing various species of entites within the universe. Capturable humans will start spawning, which you can capture and either sell, or place in battle to let out an attack. Keep in mind, these are slaves, so when you place a captured entity, its attack can also harm you.
-Weapon tweaks, including fixes for the under-powered Knock back hammer.
-Completely revamped intro sequence, and starting location 

And more! 
V0.07 Update should be released by the end of this week or at the latest, start of the next.

Stay tuned.
